title: Do I Know You?
cn: 第 1 集 · 你认识我吗
novel:
Ted stared at Stella and [[realized|realize]] he could not answer simple questions about her. Her [[favorite|favorite]] movie, her [[childhood|childhood]] pet, her [[allergies|allergy]] — he knew none of it. He [[memorized|memorize]] her likes and dislikes, filling notebooks with [[details|detail]].

At the bar, Barney [[confessed|confess]] something [[unexpected|unexpected]]. "I have feelings for Robin," he said. Ted was too [[distracted|distract]] to react. Marshall and Lily [[seized|seize]] the moment and [[arranged|arrange]] a dinner for Barney and Robin.

Robin was [[skeptical|skeptical]]. "Barney? Really?" she asked. But Lily was [[persuasive|persuasive]]. "Give him a [[genuine|genuine]] chance," she urged.

Meanwhile, Ted [[crammed|cram]] facts about Stella until his head ached. But when he met Stella for dinner, she looked puzzled. "You sound like you memorized a textbook," she said.

Ted [[hesitated|hesitate]]. "I just want to know you better."

Stella smiled. "You don't need to cram. Just ask me."

Across town, Barney sat across from Robin, sweating through his shirt. He tried to be sincere, but every sentence sounded like a pick-up line. Robin laughed. "This is [[awkward|awkward]]," she said.

"Yeah," Barney [[admitted|admit]]. "But I'm trying."

childhood.en: the time when you are a child

allergy.en: a bad reaction to certain foods or things

memorize.en: to learn something so you remember it exactly

confess.en: to tell someone a truth you feel shy about

unexpected.en: surprising because you did not expect it

seize.en: to take hold of a chance quickly

persuasive.en: able to make people believe or do something

cram.en: to study hard at the last minute

awkward.en: making people feel shy or uncomfortable

admit.en: to agree that something is true
